I asked how the algorithm works and was told:

The algorithm selects a post based on these rules:

on this day exactly one year ago
highest score, i.e. likes - dislikes
not deleted
not in subverses [v/Announcements](https://voat.co/v/Announcements) (or [v/news](https://voat.co/v/news), currently)
not in a subverse which has already been featured in [v/AYearAgo](https://voat.co/v/AYearAgo) in the last 7 days
if a link submission, the link target still exists

Previous rules in this sub didn't allow for posts like this so /v/news was excluded. Post your opinions about this below.
